caveat: Framework only: never taught, piloted or evaluated, and the 'epistemic agent' claim is asserted without engaging philosophy of technology.
title: Conceptualising student-GenAI knowledge co-creation in higher education
venue: Innovations in Education and Teaching International
why: Proposes a four-stage pedagogy (exploration, epistemic friction, simulation, circulation) treating GenAI as a co-creator and 'active epistemic agent'. Strip the model out and stages 1, 2 and 4 are inquiry, source criticism and knowledge circulation — a useful foil for Professional Criticality.
